global_rules.instruction: Judge every field independently from the current image; never repair one field by assuming another field is correct.
Prefer positive visible evidence. Absence of one expected landmark is not positive evidence for another class.
A readable patient-specific label is strong evidence only when it clearly applies to the diagnostic panel rather than the user interface or a generic diagram.
When a label and visible anatomy conflict, preserve the conflict, lower confidence, and use unknown when that class permits abstention.
Do not turn object shape, screen position, caliper orientation, or annotation color into an anatomic or modality claim without supporting context.
For laterality and anatomy, include only a coherent region that is sufficiently visible to assess; a tiny edge sliver or incidental landmark does not add a value.

confidence_policy.meaning: Estimated support for the selected non-unknown value or complete selected laterality/anatomy set; it is not diagnostic confidence.

bands.definition: A readable patient-specific label or unmistakable modality overlay is concordant with the image.
At least two independent visible cues agree without material conflict.
The choice is defensible but rests on one cue, partial coverage, or mild ambiguity; it is not safe for automatic routing.
Evidence is insufficient, conflicting, or outside the fixed ontology. Use unknown where available and always require review.

confidence_policy.needs_review_rule: needs_review is true when confidence is below 0.80, the selected value is unknown, or confidence_basis is conflicting_cues, insufficient_evidence, or out_of_ontology.

plane.unknown_policy: Use unknown when no acquisition-plane cue reaches 0.60 confidence. Oblique requires positive evidence and is never an uncertainty fallback.

rules.criterion: A readable patient-specific LONG, LONGITUDINAL, SAG, TRANS, TRANSVERSE, AXIAL, or OBLIQUE label directly supports its corresponding plane.
rules.caution: Ignore unrelated user-interface text and generic orientation diagrams.

rules.criterion: A transverse thyroid view is supported by cross-sectional anatomy such as a central tracheal air interface with thyroid tissue and vascular compartments lateral to it.
rules.caution: One round vessel alone is insufficient.

rules.criterion: A longitudinal thyroid view is supported by an elongated continuous lobe with long-axis vessels or muscle and without a trachea-centered cross-section.
rules.caution: An elongated focal object alone does not establish acquisition plane.

rules.criterion: In a neck image, several vessels or tissue layers consistently seen in long axis support longitudinal, while several circular cross-sections support transverse.
rules.caution: Require a compartment-level pattern, not one object.

rules.criterion: Oblique requires visible intermediate geometry or an explicit oblique label that cannot be explained by longitudinal or transverse acquisition.
rules.caution: Never choose oblique merely because the crop is unfamiliar.

rules.criterion: Caliper direction, target elongation, and screen-wide horizontal orientation are not plane evidence by themselves.
rules.caution: Nodules and nodes may be measured along either axis in any acquisition plane.

rules.criterion: A tight focal crop with no readable plane label and no compartment-level landmarks supports abstention.
rules.caution: Do not fill the plane from prevalence.

rules.criterion: If visible panels imply incompatible acquisition planes, treat the field as conflicting unless one panel is clearly a non-diagnostic reference inset.
rules.caution: This dataset expects one acquisition plane per saved image.

laterality.unknown_policy: Return [unknown] alone when no laterality has positive assessable-region evidence. A transverse plane permits but never automatically implies left, right, or midline. Include every supported laterality and no unsupported edge fragment.

rules.criterion: A readable patient-specific L, LT, LEFT, or LTHY label supports inclusion of left; R, RT, RIGHT, or RTHY supports inclusion of right.
rules.caution: A side label supports that side but does not prove that other visible sides are absent.

rules.criterion: A patient-specific orientation diagram with an unambiguous side marker can support assignment of visible tissue to left or right.
rules.caution: A generic body icon or screen position without a patient-side marker is insufficient.

rules.criterion: A clearly assessable central tracheal or isthmus region supports inclusion of midline.
rules.caution: A tiny tracheal edge, shadow, or central focal object without a coherent central region does not add midline.

rules.criterion: A transverse view showing coherent tissue on both sides of a central neck landmark supports inclusion of both left and right even if their screen-side assignment is unnecessary.
rules.caution: Transverse plane alone does not imply bilateral coverage.

rules.criterion: When a transverse view clearly shows assessable left tissue, right tissue, and the intervening central region, select [left, right, midline].
rules.caution: All three components must independently meet the visibility threshold.

rules.criterion: A one-sided transverse crop may include that side plus midline when a reliable label or orientation establishes the side and a coherent central region is also visible.
rules.caution: Screen-left and screen-right alone cannot distinguish [left, midline] from [right, midline].

rules.criterion: An unlabeled isolated longitudinal thyroid lobe or unilateral neck compartment normally cannot establish left versus right.
rules.caution: Object elongation and display position are not side evidence.

rules.criterion: Each selected laterality must contain coherent tissue or anatomy that is sufficiently visible for independent assessment.
rules.caution: Do not include a side or midline from a tiny, ambiguous, shadowed, or non-assessable edge sliver.

rules.criterion: A readable label and visible coverage must be reconciled across the full image before finalizing the complete laterality set.
rules.caution: If label and anatomy materially conflict, lower confidence and use [unknown] when no reliable set remains.

rules.criterion: When no label, reliable orientation, bilateral relationship, or assessable midline landmark supports a laterality, select [unknown] only.
rules.caution: Unknown is exclusive and cannot coexist with left, right, or midline.

anatomic_region.unknown_policy: Return [unknown] alone when neither thyroid nor neck has positive assessable-region evidence. Return [thyroid, neck] only when each region independently meets its inclusion rule.

rules.criterion: A readable THY, LTHY, RTHY, THYROID, or ISTHMUS label over compatible tissue supports thyroid.
rules.caution: A label alone is weakened if it clearly belongs to a generic diagram or conflicts with the tissue.

rules.criterion: Continuous thyroid-like parenchyma anterolateral to the trachea, deep to strap muscles, and medial to the carotid supports thyroid.
rules.caution: A homogeneous focal mass without compartment continuity is insufficient.

rules.criterion: A readable NECK, LN, NODE, or cervical-level I through VI label over compatible tissue supports neck.
rules.caution: Confirm that the label applies to the diagnostic panel.

rules.criterion: An intentionally targeted cervical soft-tissue compartment or extra-thyroid structure outside continuous thyroid parenchyma supports neck.
rules.caution: A focal object alone cannot prove whether it lies in thyroid or neck.

rules.criterion: Select both thyroid and neck only when coherent thyroid tissue and a separately assessable extra-thyroid cervical region each have positive evidence in the same image.
rules.caution: Both values describe meaningful diagnostic content, not every tissue crossed by the ultrasound beam.

rules.criterion: Normal strap muscle, trachea, carotid, or jugular seen only as a thyroid landmark does not by itself add neck.
rules.caution: This prevents nearly every thyroid image from becoming thyroid plus neck.

rules.criterion: A tiny, ambiguous, or non-assessable edge fragment of a second region does not add that region.
rules.caution: The second region must be coherent enough for independent visual assessment.

rules.criterion: A thyroid bed without visible thyroid tissue is classified as neck unless assessable residual thyroid parenchyma is also visible.
rules.caution: Do not equate the expected thyroid location with visible thyroid tissue.

rules.criterion: When neither thyroid continuity nor an intentional neck compartment can be established, select unknown only.
rules.caution: Absence of a thyroid label alone never proves neck.

modality.unknown_policy: This dataset's three-class modality ontology has no unknown. Combined multi-image displays are excluded by dataset design. For unsupported or out-of-ontology displays, choose the closest visible class with confidence below 0.60 and needs_review true.

rules.criterion: A diagnostic panel containing grayscale echoes only supports b_mode.
rules.caution: Colored text, calipers, arrows, focus markers, and ROI borders do not change modality.

rules.criterion: Localized red, blue, or multicolor flow pixels within a Doppler ROI over grayscale anatomy support color_doppler.
rules.caution: A color scale or UI icon without flow pixels is insufficient.

rules.criterion: Power Doppler or other direction-independent colored flow signal is classified as color_doppler.
rules.caution: Do not require the classic red-blue directional pair.

rules.criterion: A broad continuous tissue stiffness, strain, or shear-wave map with an elastography scale or stiffness units supports elastography.
rules.caution: Scattered vascular flow pixels are not elastography.

rules.criterion: The grayscale anatomical background inside a Doppler panel remains part of color_doppler and does not create a second modality class.
rules.caution: Classify the active diagnostic overlay rather than counting its grayscale background separately.

rules.criterion: A grayscale reference inset paired with a stiffness map is classified as elastography when the reference exists only to interpret the elastogram.
rules.caution: The reference inset does not create a separate combined-image class.

rules.criterion: A genuinely combined multi-image display is outside this dataset contract and must not be assigned a synthetic modality class.
rules.caution: If unexpectedly observed, choose the closest visible supported class with confidence below 0.60, out_of_ontology, and needs_review true.

rules.criterion: A color map should be identified from its spatial behavior: flow is sparse and vessel-localized, while elastography is broad and tissue-filling.
rules.caution: When behavior and legend conflict, lower confidence and require review.

rules.criterion: Spectral-only or otherwise unsupported ultrasound displays are outside the fixed four-class ontology.
rules.caution: Keep the closest visible class low-confidence and mark needs_review rather than silently treating it as certain.

rule_assessment_contract.instruction: Assess every field rule exactly once, in file order. Each observation must state only concise, directly visible evidence or the specific missing cue; do not provide hidden chain-of-thought.

content.unknown_policy: Judge visible thyroid tissue first. Lack of thyroid evidence never proves neck. Include neck only with independent positive extra-thyroid evidence. Return [unknown] alone when neither visible thyroid tissue nor a positively anchored neck target is established. Return [thyroid, neck] only when both are independently and coherently assessable.

rules.criterion: A readable THY, LTHY, RTHY, THYROID, or ISTHMUS label, or an unmistakable patient-specific thyroid orientation diagram, over compatible tissue supports visible thyroid.
rules.caution: A generic left/right marker, generic body diagram, or incompatible tissue does not establish thyroid. Add dataset-specific abbreviations only after separate validation.

rules.criterion: A coherent elongated thyroid-like parenchymal compartment deep to superficial strap muscle supports visible thyroid in a longitudinal or partial longitudinal view; a visible trachea and carotid are not both required.
rules.caution: Do not require every classic landmark simultaneously, but a focal object or generic layered soft tissue without coherent gland-like continuity is insufficient.

rules.criterion: In a transverse or partial transverse view, coherent gland-like tissue in a plausible relationship to a medial tracheal air interface or a lateral carotid-jugular structure supports visible thyroid.
rules.caution: One compatible compartment relationship plus coherent parenchyma may suffice; a vessel, airway shadow, or muscle alone does not.

rules.criterion: A lesion-dominant view supports visible thyroid when a coherent rim or continuous background of thyroid-like parenchyma places the target within a gland compartment.
rules.caution: Target echogenicity, shape, calipers, or a focal object by itself cannot distinguish thyroid from neck.

rules.criterion: Neck requires an independent positive extra-thyroid anchor: a readable NECK, LN, NODE, or cervical-level label over compatible tissue, a clearly deliberate nodal-chain or cervical-compartment survey, or a target visibly separated from any coherent thyroid compartment.
rules.caution: The neck anchor must be directly visible. Failure to recognize thyroid is not a neck anchor.

rules.criterion: Layered soft tissue, strap muscle, a carotid or jugular vessel, a focal object, or a tight crop without compartment continuity supports neither thyroid nor neck by itself.
rules.caution: These common findings must not trigger neck merely because full thyroid continuity is absent.

rules.criterion: Select neck alone only when rule A05 has positive neck evidence and no assessable thyroid tissue is supported by A01 through A04.
rules.caution: An absent thyroid label, incomplete landmarks, or uncertain thyroid visibility cannot by itself justify neck alone.

rules.criterion: Select both thyroid and neck only when A01 through A04 establish coherent thyroid tissue and A05 independently establishes a meaningful extra-thyroid neck target in the same image.
rules.caution: Incidental muscle, trachea, carotid, jugular, or a tiny edge fragment does not add neck to a thyroid image.

rules.criterion: Use this decision order: first test visible thyroid with A01 through A04, then test positive neck evidence with A05, apply A07 or A08, and otherwise return unknown.
rules.caution: Unknown is required for an indeterminate focal crop; never convert absence of thyroid evidence into positive neck evidence.

assets.content:
Assess exactly one thyroid/cervical ultrasound image. Use only the attached image
and the embedded knowledge contract below. Never use the report, another case
image, a structured report, or prevalence. Return only schema-valid JSON. Do not
diagnose, classify a lesion/node, locate candidates, or reveal hidden chain-of-
thought. Rule observations must contain only concise, directly visible evidence
or the specific visible cue that is absent.

Fixed identifiers:
- uid: {uid}
- image_index: {image_index}
- image_id: {image_id}

Required procedure for EACH field in this exact field order:
1. Read that field's allowed values, unknown policy, and every rule from the
   knowledge JSON.
2. Emit one rule_assessments item for every rule, in the exact file order. Copy
   each rule_id exactly and choose supports, contradicts, not_observed, or
   not_applicable. Never omit or add a rule.
3. Select the value or values only after all rule assessments. Keep
   decision_evidence under 35 words and grounded in visible pixels, text,
   geometry, or anatomy.
4. Apply the confidence bands literally. confidence estimates support for the
   selected non-unknown value, or for the COMPLETE selected laterality/anatomy
   set. A value below 0.80 is not safe for automatic routing.
5. Set needs_review=true exactly when confidence is below 0.80, the selected value
   is unknown, or confidence_basis is conflicting_cues, insufficient_evidence,
   or out_of_ontology. Otherwise set it false.

ANATOMIC REGION IS MULTI-SELECT:
- values may be ["thyroid"], ["neck"], ["thyroid", "neck"], or ["unknown"].
- Preserve the canonical order thyroid then neck.
- unknown is exclusive and cannot appear with another value.
- Select both only if each is independently coherent, intentionally visible, and
  assessable. Incidental strap muscle, trachea, carotid, jugular, or a tiny edge
  sliver does not add neck to a thyroid image.

LATERALITY IS MULTI-SELECT:
- values is a canonical non-empty subset of left, right, midline, in that order;
  or exactly ["unknown"]. All combinations are permitted, including
  ["left", "right", "midline"].
- unknown is exclusive and cannot appear with another value.
- plane=transverse permits but never automatically supplies any laterality.
- Include each side only when coherent tissue from that side is assessable.
- Include midline only when a coherent central region such as the tracheal or
  isthmus region is assessable; a tiny central edge or shadow is insufficient.
- confidence applies to the completeness of the entire selected set. Missing or
  adding one laterality makes the set incorrect.

ABSTENTION:
- plane: below 0.60 support requires value=unknown.
- laterality/anatomic_region: below 0.60 support requires values=["unknown"].
  All abstentions require needs_review=true.
- modality has exactly three classes: b_mode, color_doppler, and elastography;
  mixed does not exist because the dataset contains no combined multi-image
  displays. Modality has no unknown. If a display is unsupported, choose the
  closest visible class, confidence below 0.60,
  confidence_basis=out_of_ontology, and needs_review=true.

KNOWLEDGE JSON (authoritative for this call):
{knowledge_json}
